(set-logic QF_LIA)
(declare-const start_A Int)
(declare-const start_B Int)
(declare-const start_C Int)
(assert (and (>= start_A 0) (<= start_A 6)))
(assert (and (>= start_B 0) (<= start_B 6)))
(assert (and (>= start_C 0) (<= start_C 6)))
(assert (or (<= (+ start_A 2) start_B) (<= (+ start_B 3) start_A)))
(assert (or (<= (+ start_A 2) start_C) (<= (+ start_C 1) start_A)))
(assert (or (<= (+ start_B 3) start_C) (<= (+ start_C 1) start_B)))
(minimize (ite (>= (ite (>= (+ start_A 2) (+ start_B 3)) (+ start_A 2) (+ start_B 3)) (+ start_C 1)) (ite (>= (+ start_A 2) (+ start_B 3)) (+ start_A 2) (+ start_B 3)) (+ start_C 1)))
(check-sat)
